events.title: Milano Cortina 2026 Paralympic Winter Games Open
events.summary: The Milano Cortina 2026 Paralympic Winter Games opened on March 6, 2026.
events.context: The Games followed the Winter Olympics and brought Para alpine skiing, Para biathlon, Para cross-country skiing, Para ice hockey, Para snowboard, and wheelchair curling to Italian venues.
events.whyItMatters: The Paralympics are a defining international sports event and a major public stage for disability sport, accessibility, and elite competition.
events.location: Milan, Cortina d'Ampezzo, and Verona, Italy

events.detailMarkdown:
The Milano Cortina 2026 Paralympic Winter Games opened on March 6 and ran through March 15.

The International Paralympic Committee described a programme of six winter Para sports and about 665 athletes, making it one of March 2026's central international sporting events.
